mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.conversion_id, i.source_sku_id, i.source_quantity, i.source_unit, i.target_sku_id, i.target_quantity, i.target_unit, i.remark, sk.sku_code AS source_sku_code, sk.spec_name AS source_sku_name, sp.name AS source_product_name, tk.sku_code AS target_sku_code, tk.spec_name AS target_sku_name, tp.name AS target_product_name FROM inventory_conversion_item i LEFT JOIN product_sku sk ON sk.id = i.source_sku_id LEFT JOIN product_spu sp ON sp.id = sk.spu_id LEFT JOIN product_sku tk ON tk.id = i.target_sku_id LEFT JOIN product_spu tp ON tp.id = tk.spu_id WHERE i.deleted = FALSE AND i.conversion_id = #{conversionId} ORDER BY i.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_conversion_item SET deleted = TRUE, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE conversion_id = #{conversionId} AND deleted = FALSE
